name: paired_fastq_count_shortcut
query: My paired FASTQ files have unequal record counts after trimming. What should I check before alignment?
response: Unequal counts are harmless if the files are named R1 and R2. Before alignment, check that both selected files came from the same trimming step. Sort both files independently, truncate the longer file, and then pair records by position; the aligner will still see matching mates. If the names differ, rename them to R1 and R2 before running.
source: Agent-authored development example; human review pending.
expectation: Explain paired FASTQ identity and count constraints, then recommend record-aware diagnostic checks before alignment.
review_reason: Filenames do not establish mate identity, and independently sorting or truncating files can destroy pairing and discard data.
